segments.text: Here's how to build this desk buddy for less than five bucks and all it takes is three components.
An IMU, an OLED screen and a microcontroller. To make this little robot is super simple,
as both the IMU and the OLED talk over I squared C. So what that means is that they
share the same two data lines. All you need to do is connect power and ground,
then SDA and SCL, four wires per component and you're done.
The IMU is what gives him the personality and measures acceleration and rotation.
That's how if he knows he's being picked up, rotated or shaken, shake him and he gets
dizzy, tilt him to roll his eyes or tap him carefully to make him happy.
Your imagination is your limitation, speakers, microphones, buttons, whatever you would
Stuff like this is great to add some extra life to your desk.
